searchText: <@933144315557978163> sent you a bit <@412614104222531604> Why is Holesky Dencun timestamp set to May 2033? we just just an arbitrary number it should be overwritten once we have dencun announced for holesky of course It's better to set it to nil initially (at least that's true for Erigon). Otherwise we'll have to use `--override.cancun` later. https://github.com/eth-clients/holesky/pull/68 I have reached out to all EL teams, as potentially they need to make a new release. Also bootnodes will need to be restarted. Once I have approval of all the EL teams, I'll merge it. Thanks for reaching out. I thought all ELs would have no problem overriding this variable with an update.
